summary: Become plugins, added in Ansible 2.8, let Ansible use privilege escalation tools such as sudo, su and doas to run commands and modules as another user.
questions: What are become plugins used for?
Which privilege escalation tools can Ansible use through become plugins?
Since which Ansible version do become plugins exist?

answer_card.title: What become plugins do
answer_card.answer_md: Become plugins (added in 2.8) let Ansible use privilege escalation utilities like `sudo`, `su` and `doas`, so commands and modules can run with another user's permissions on the target.
